name: Voices, blaming, blood and she
source:
This is a story about how far a teenager can go to achieve her dreams. You must help the girl get to the room where all dreams come true. 

What does a child with schizophrenia think about? What worries her? What does she dream about? 

The player is the girl's inner voice, which must cope with all the difficulties on the way to the room of desires.

[Edited from [url=https://gattapelatta.itch.io/vbbas]itch.io[/url]]
